user_query: I'm a basketball fan and I want to know the currency exchange rate from AUD to USD. Also, fetch me the latest NBA game results and statistics of the players who scored the highest points in those games.

TaskList.description: Fetch the current currency exchange rate from AUD to USD.
Retrieve the latest NBA game results.
Identify the players who scored the highest points in the latest NBA games using the results from Task 2.
Fetch detailed statistics of the highest scoring players identified in Task 3.
